name: engineering-standards
description: Engineering skills + review/context enforcement hooks for build teams working with SMB Strategy Consultants. Companion to the builder-team-core CLAUDE.md workspace overlay — installing this plugin turns REVIEW.md and CONTEXT-WINDOW-CONTROL.md from advisory prose into an enforced Stop-hook gate and a context nag, and keeps the 12 engineering skills auto-updating instead of pinned to whatever was in the zip at download time.
